title: Ukrainian Cheesy Oven Gratin
description: A creamy, cheesy Ukrainian-inspired gratin, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is a twist on traditional Ukrainian cuisine.
instructions: Open the Ukrainian package and unroll it.
Transfer the Ukrainian to the baking dish.
Sprinkle the shredded Cheddar cheese over the Ukrainian.
Sprinkle the crushed Crisp over the Cheddar cheese.
Dot the top of the gratin with butter.
Pour the milk over the top of the gratin.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
